answer_1.quote: We cast molecule caption generation (MoCG) as a crossmodal alignment task ... In translation from molecule to language, we assess using BLEU-2, BLEU-4, ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, ROUGE-L, and METEOR metrics.

answer_2.quote: For evaluation, we employ established statistical metrics (see Appendix H), in addition to our atomic-level cross-NLI evaluation method. When evaluating the performance of both baselines and our models, we employ BLEU-2, BLEU-4, ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, ROUGE-L, METEOR, BLEU, Levenshtein distance, fingerprint metrics (MACCS, RDK, Morgan), Fréchet ChemNet Distance (FCD), and molecule validity metrics.
